200211088.title: RNA-Seq and snRNA-seq analysis of Sleep deprivation in Wildtype Mice
200211088.summary: This dataset constitutes the first snRNA-Seq study of gene expression following sleep deprivation in wildtype mice with paralell bulk-RNA-seq data. In addition it contains RNA-seq analysis of the effect of recovery sleep following sleep deprivation
200211088.gdstype: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
